title: Host telemetry missing
summary: Host telemetry is down or absent for ten minutes.
description: Check the host exporter and metrics ingestion before interpreting dependent alerts.

title: Root filesystem above 75%
summary: The root filesystem is above 75% used.
description: This does not estimate recoverable Docker storage.

title: Root filesystem above 85%
summary: The root filesystem is above 85% used.
description: Free space is at risk; inspect data growth and cleanup options.

title: Root filesystem below 10 GiB free
summary: The root filesystem has less than 10 GiB free.
description: Act before writes fail.

title: Root filesystem predicted to fill in 72 hours
summary: Observed root-filesystem trend predicts exhaustion within 72 hours.
description: Requires 300 one-minute observations and a trend window spanning at least five hours.

title: Host memory above 85%
summary: Host memory use is sustained above 85%.
description: Inspect container and database memory consumers.

title: Monitoring collector failed or stale
expr: (((max(countyiq_monitor_collector_success{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host",collector=~"containers|dagster|caddy|postgres|sources|recovery|openrouter|storage"} == bool 0) or vector(0)) + (max((time() - countyiq_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host",collector=~"containers|dagster|caddy|postgres|sources|recovery|openrouter"}) > bool 900) or vector(0)) + ((((count(countyiq_monitor_collector_success{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host",collector=~"containers|dagster|caddy|postgres|sources|recovery|openrouter|storage"}) or vector(0)) < bool 8) + ((count(countyiq_monitor_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host",collector=~"containers|dagster|caddy|postgres|sources|recovery|openrouter|storage"}) or vector(0)) < bool 8)) * scalar(up{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host"} == bool 1))) > bool 0)
summary: A required monitoring collector is failing, stale, or missing.
description: The eight required collectors are containers, dagster, caddy, postgres, sources, recovery, openrouter, and storage. Missing custom metrics are suppressed while the host is down.

title: Docker storage collection stale
summary: Docker storage inventory is older than two hours.
description: Storage collection is hourly, so this has a longer freshness window.

title: Container not running or unhealthy
summary: A managed service is not running or unhealthy.
description: Grouped by bounded service label; do not add process or request identifiers.

title: Container restart or OOM
summary: A managed service has restarted repeatedly or was OOM-killed.
description: OOM kills are read from the cgroup-v2 counter, so an old Docker inspect state cannot keep this alert firing.

title: Dagster heartbeat missing
summary: A Dagster daemon heartbeat is older than five minutes.
description: Check daemon health and service logs.

title: Dagster queued run delayed
summary: A queued Dagster run has waited over 30 minutes.
description: Inspect queue capacity and daemon health.

title: Dagster run exceeds six hours
summary: A running or starting Dagster run is older than six hours.
description: Inspect run state without creating an alert per run identifier.

title: Backup missing or failed
summary: The last backup is older than 30 hours, failed, or its timer is inactive.
description: Check the backup timer, service logs, and destination.

title: Restore drill overdue
summary: No restore drill has completed in 30 days.
description: Run and record a restore verification.

title: R2 capacity high or guard tripped
summary: R2 use exceeds 85% of the configured limit or the cost guard tripped.
description: Reduce stored data or correct the limit and guard configuration.

title: R2 cost guard stale
summary: The R2 cost guard has not run within one hour.
description: Investigate guard collection before relying on capacity alerts.

title: Source unhealthy or stale
expr: (((countyiq_source_healthy{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host"} == bool 0) + (countyiq_source_stale{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host"} == bool 1)) > bool 0) * on(instance, job) group_left() (countyiq_monitor_collector_success{instance="countyiq-production",job="countyiq/host",collector="sources"} == bool 1)
summary: A source is unhealthy or stale while its collector is succeeding.
description: The collector alert handles collection failures; this rule avoids duplicating that root cause.

title: PostgreSQL capacity or blocking
summary: PostgreSQL connections exceed 85% of capacity or sessions are blocked.
description: Investigate connection use and blocked work; this is one aggregate alert, not one per session.

title: Intelligence integrity check failed
summary: The intelligence integrity check is failing.
description: Investigate pipeline outputs and the associated collector state.

title: External readiness failed
summary: An external location cannot confirm HTTP 200 and database readiness.
description: Check application readiness, Cloudflare Access health credentials, and the synthetic execution log. Redirects and login pages are failures.

title: External readiness probe data missing
summary: One or both external locations have not reported for at least 15 minutes.
description: Check that the readiness check is enabled, both selected probes are online, and synthetic metrics are arriving. This alert does not depend on the VPS exporter.
